en: Are you okay...?
...Yeah, somehow.

I-I'm sort of stuck here!
Someone...help me out!
Himiko! Careful...
Nyeh...I'm saved...
We made it...

Hey, how were we saved?
Why are we still alive?
Ah... Yeah, why are we alive...?
I wonder...
<CLT=cltMIND>The killing game is over...
<CLT=cltMIND>The class trials are over...
<CLT=cltMIND>And the fictional world...is over.
<CLT=cltMIND>So then...where are we?

<CLT=cltMIND>Another fictional world
after the fiction has ended?
<CLT=cltMIND>What's left for us here?

<CLT=cltMIND>We were silent for a long while,
staring into "<CLT=cltSTRONG>the other side<CLT=cltMIND>."
<CLT=cltMIND>Where we continued to hope...
<CLT=cltMIND>And they continued to torture us...
<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=cltMIND>.
<CLT=cltMIND>53 times, hope moved forward.
<CLT=cltMIND>53 times, the suffering continued.

<CLT=cltMIND>The world on the other side of
the fiction, <CLT=cltSTRONG>the real world<CLT=cltMIND>.
So, what do we do now?

We didn't think of a plan for what to do after.
I thought that was the end of us back there.
But we survived.
...And that's the truth.

It seems as though we don't really have a
choice...we can't stay here anymore.

But...I don't get it.
Seriously, how are we still alive?

When this world destroyed itself,
I thought we would go down with it.
Keebo probably saved us.
He made sure we didn't die.
But why...would he do that?

There's no point in us escaping to the outside
world... We're just fictional characters...

Did Keebo save us...because he was acting on
what the <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world wanted<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Then maybe...
this is what the <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world wanted<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Nyeh? For us to live?

That's right. In addition to ending all this...
<CLT=cltSTRONG>The outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> wanted us to live...

I suppose...<CLT=cltSTRONG>the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>
wanted this lie to become the truth.

So, come on, everyone. Let's head outside.
With confidence.
The outside world is waiting.

To the outside world, huh?
I wonder what kind of world it is.

A peaceful world with no fighting and no 
despair. That's what Tsumugi said, right?
Yeah. Ah...if she wasn't lying.
Nyeh!? It might be a lie!?
Remember...the last thing Tsumugi said?

My plan was such a flawless <CLT=cltSTRONG>copy<CLT=typeNORMAL>,
it even failed right at the end...

So I should be able to hold my head up 
high as a <CLT=cltSTRONG>cosplaycat criminal<CLT=typeNORMAL>, right?
She said <CLT=cltSTRONG>"copy"<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

That means she must have been
<CLT=cltSTRONG>copying<CLT=cltNORMAL> someone, right?
What does that mean?
What indeed...
What!? You don't know!?
Ah, well, I have some theories.

Perhaps <CLT=cltSTRONG>Hope's Peak Academy<CLT=cltNORMAL> and the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL> really exist.

Maybe Tsumugi was just basing
her performance on them.

So Tsumugi lied about this whole world being
just fiction?
Wh-What!? A surprise ending!?

No, I don't really know for sure. She might have
been lying when she said <CLT=cltSTRONG>"copy."<CLT=cltNORMAL>

But if she were telling the truth, then...it would
make sense that <CLT=cltSTRONG>that<CLT=cltNORMAL> was a lie.
What do you mean, <CLT=cltSTRONG>"that"<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

What Tsumugi showed us...
The way we were when...we first arrived.
H-Huh? Wh-What am I wearing?

Mm-hm! Looking good! Now you look more
like <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>...? Really?

Next up, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory<CLT=cltNORMAL> youse all been
waiting for.

Hell yeah! Get ready! Once the seal is broken,
we'll be in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>domain of the killing game<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
<CLT=cltMIND>K-Killing game...?
You mean...we were selected!?

We got picked!?
Really!? Alright!

Wh-Whoa, really!?
I'm selected for <CLT=cltSTRONG>it<CLT=cltNORMAL>, too!?

I still don't believe it. I can't believe that any
of us would volunteer for this.

We forgot everything about our old selves 
after that first Flashback Light, didn't we?

That's what Tsumugi said, but...
something's been bugging me about that.

Even if we were obsessed with this killing game,
I still can't believe we would participate in it.
I just... I don't believe it.

Ah, but...
I don't really have any logic behind that...
One of Kaito's hunches, huh?

Anyway, there's no way for us to check when
we all applied to the Academy, right?
Yeah...
What? We can't check?

So in the end...we still don't know what
was true or not...

The fictional world ends here, and the
real world lies out there.
Perhaps just beyond here is the truth...
But, maybe it isn't...

Maybe it's all still fiction 
in that world, or...

Maybe Danganronpa still continues 
in that world, or...

Or maybe the outside world is the same
as this world.
It might be a world...filled with lies.

Well...if we can get out from here,
we'll know for sure.

Yeah...but I feel like...there's not too much
meaning in truth and lies...
Nyeh? What do you mean?

I mean that...even if something
is a lie, even if it's fiction...

If it has the power to change the world,
then it must contain some kind of truth.
Aren't we proof of that?

In this fictional world, we overcame
all these fictional struggles...

But those things changed us.
And we were able to change the world.

So it doesn't really matter where
the truth ends and where the lies begin.

If <CLT=cltSTRONG>lies<CLT=cltNORMAL> can change the world
just as well as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth<CLT=cltNORMAL> can...

Then lies...are just another way
of telling the truth.

Some lies can lead the world to hope...
Some truths can lead the world to despair...

So I don't think anyone can really say which
is more <CLT=cltSTRONG>right<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the end.

I guess it's not important whether it's 
a truth or lie. Just what it leads to...
Yeah. That's what I believe.

We stand with one foot in fiction,
and one foot in reality...

Then, we need to see for ourselves whether this
fictional world has changed the outside world.
And what we can do from this point on...

You're right. We can't stay in this 
fictional world forever. It's already over.

We gotta take all the experience we earned
in this world and go on to the next.
Yeah. Let's go.

We'll see what this world gained, and what it
lost, and all the rest.
Let's find out, together.
<CLT=cltMIND>To the other side of this world...
<CLT=cltMIND>To the other side of fiction...
<CLT=cltMIND>Let's find out, together.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's what we could accomplish.
<CLT=cltMIND>The story lives on.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure, even now...

<CLT=cltMIND>Even on the other side... 
It lives on there, as well.
<CLT=cltMIND>And thus, the story lives on.
<CLT=cltMIND>Was this lie able to change something?
<CLT=cltMIND>Was this lie able to change someone?
<CLT=cltMIND>Was this lie...able to change the world?

<CLT=cltMIND>If it was able to change
even the smallest thing...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Then the story isn't over.
